algorithm: PPO with LLM-authored (GPT-4) reward search + reward-aware physics prior domain randomization
success_criterion: fitness = clip(ω_z, -0.25, 0.25) summed over all steps within an episode
headline_metric: total rotation (rad) over a fixed 20s real-world trial
headline_value: DrEureka Best 9.39±4.15 rad, 20.00±0.00s vs. Human-Designed 3.24±1.66 rad, 20.00±0.00s (Table II)
paper_code_mismatch: The released DrEureka repo (code/md) contains only forward_locomotion/ and globe_walking/ trees; the LEAP-hand cube-rotation training/deployment code and the quoted Prompt-13 reward are the LEAP-hand authors' own code, not included in the released repo, so the cube-rotation reward cannot be cross-checked against a code file.
note_gaps: No plain-Eureka (reward-only, no DR) ablation is run for cube rotation, and no per-trial/rollout count is given for the cube-rotation real-world evaluation beyond the general '3 random seeds per DR configuration' protocol.
